digest.component_or_area: LLM runtime auth injection via ProviderSession
propositions: Provider-native auth/session capabilities must be injected through ProviderSession builders without forking the RP-01 authoritative path or creating second clients/runners
LLMRuntime auth capabilities must remain non-serializable and excluded from LLMConfig, RunRequest, snapshots, fingerprints, caches, schemas, and public output
Provider-native capability doubles must reach exactly one Rebar-owned official client lifecycle with no raw token extraction outside the adapter
Missing or conflicting explicit auth must fail before provider model requests without fallback to anonymous, alternate-principal, or cross-provider alternatives
Unchanged RP-01 authoritative tests (S2/S3/S5, candidate-tracing, budget, cache, exhaustion, artifacts, tracing, usage, failure contracts) must pass with auth injection integrated
Bounded live Anthropic and Bedrock auth/cache canaries on production-equivalent infrastructure must complete successfully with redacted evidence recorded and no credential material leaked
